evidence.observed_facts: Official Nodeul Island Livehouse facility page (nodeul.org/facility/livehouse/, fetched 2026-08-15) states: location Nodeul Island 1F; area 1,320 m²; capacity 456 designated seats / 708 standing; performance rental hours 10:00-23:00, prep/teardown rental 10:00-22:00; 2026 rental rate table (VAT excluded) — Sat/Sun/holiday event rental KRW 4,000,000 for 1 performance and KRW 6,000,000 for 2 performances, with the rule that a single performance exceeding 3 hours is billed as 2 performances; prep/teardown rental KRW 1,067,000 per slot on Sat/Sun/holidays; rental includes sound/lighting/instrument equipment, one house manager, four ushers, dressing rooms, lobby, ticket booth. USD conversion basis: ECB 2026-08-14 reference (EUR 1 = USD 1.1567; EUR 1 = KRW 1632.42; 1 KRW = 0.0007085799 USD); an 8-hour 09:00-17:00 event would exceed the 3-hour single-performance runtime, so the published Saturday 2-performance rate KRW 6,000,000 x 0.0007085799 = USD 4,251.48 is used as the 8-hour cost figure; VAT excluded; separate prep/teardown and event-specific terms apply. evidence.inference: Nodeul Island Livehouse is a Seoul city-run performance venue (Seoul Foundation for Arts & Culture) with published 2026 KRW rates and a standard performance window through 23:00; it is oversized for a 50-person community event (456-708 capacity) and its published start time is 10:00, so the assessed 09:00-17:00 window requires start-time confirmation; retained as a scored candidate with availability/screen/Wi-Fi/quotes open.
